PROCESSED')\\ndisp(' ')\\n\\nclear obj\\nobj = objs;\\nclear objs\\n\\n%% convert params to a struct array (just for convenience)\\ntemp = params;\\nclear params\\nfor sessix = 1:numel(meta)\\n    temp2 = rmfield(temp,{'probe','trialid','cluid','cluid_all','probeid','probeid_all'});\\n    temp2.probe = temp.probe{sessix};\\n    temp2.trialid = temp.trialid{sessix};\\n    temp2.cluid = temp.cluid{sessix};\\n    temp2.cluid_all = temp.cluid_all{sessix};\\n    temp2.probeid = temp.probeid{sessix};\\n    temp2.probeid_all = temp.probeid_all{sessix};\\n    params(sessix) = temp2;\\nend\\n```\\n\\n**Summary:** This is the orchestrator function that loads all data for multiple sessions. It calls `loadObjs()` to load raw data objects, then iterates through each session and probe number, calling `processData()` for each combination. It handles both single-probe and dual-probe recordings, concatenating probe data when needed. Finally, it converts params to a struct array for convenience.\\n\\n---\\n\\n### 2. **loadObjs.m**\\n**Full Content:**\\n```matlab\\nfunction obj = loadObjs(meta)\\nfor i = 1:numel(meta)\\n    dat = load(meta(i).datapth);\\n    if ~isfield(dat.obj,'meta')\\n        dat.obj.meta = 'assigning to avoid dissimilar struct error';\\n    end\\n    if ~isfield(dat.obj,'ex')\\n        dat.obj.ex = 'assigning to avoid dissimilar struct error';\\n    end\\n    if ~isfield(dat.obj,'me')\\n        dat.obj.me = 'assigning to avoid dissimilar struct error';\\n    end\\n    obj(i) = dat.obj;\\n    clear dat\\nend\\nend % loadObjs\\n```\\n\\n**Summary:** Simple loading function that reads MATLAB data files specified in `meta(i).datapth` for each session. Ensures struct compatibility by adding placeholder fields (meta, ex, me) if they don't exist. Returns an array of data objects.\\n\\n---\\n\\n### 3. **processData.m**\\n**Full Content:**\\n```matlab\\nfunction [params,obj] = processData(obj,params,prbnum, varargin)\\n\\n% varargin only accepts one input right now -> params.behav_only. If 1,\\n% don't process clusters\\nif nargin > 3\\n    behav_only = varargin{1};\\nelse\\n    behav_only = 0;\\nend\\n\\n%% STANDARD ROUTINES\\n% find trials to use (only need to do this once)\\nif prbnum==1 || ~isfield(params,'trialid')\\n    params.trialid = findTrials(obj, params.condition);\\n    disp(' ')\\n    disp('--Trials Found')\\n    disp(' ')\\nend\\n\\n% find clusters to use\\nparams.cluid{prbnum} = findClusters({obj.clu{prbnum}(:).quality}', params.quality);\\ndisp(' ')\\ndisp('--Clusters Found')\\ndisp(' ')\\n\\nif behav_only\\n    return\\nend\\n\\n% align spikes in every cluster to an event\\nobj = alignSpikes(obj,params,prbnum);\\ndisp(' ')\\ndisp('--Spikes Aligned')\\ndisp(' ')\\n\\n% get trial avg psth and single trial data\\nif ~isfield(params,'bctype') % boundary condition for smoothing\\n    params.bctype = 'none';\\nend\\nobj = getSeq(obj,params,prbnum);\\ndisp(' ')\\ndisp('--PSTHs and Single Trial Data Done')\\ndisp(' ')\\n\\n% remove low fr clusters\\n[obj, params.cluid{prbnum}] = removeLowFRClusters(obj,params.cluid{prbnum},params.lowFR,prbnum);\\nparams.probeid{prbnum} = ones(size(params.cluid{prbnum})) * prbnum;\\ndisp(' ')\\ndisp('--Removed Low Firing Rate Clusters')\\ndisp(' ')\\n\\n% get mean fr and std dev for each cluster/trial type during presample (baseline fr)\\n[obj.presampleFR{prbnum}, obj.presampleSigma{prbnum}] = baselineFR(obj,params,prbnum);\\ndisp(' ')\\ndisp('--Presample Statisitics Calculated')\\ndisp(' ')\\n\\nend\\n```\\n\\n**Summary:** Main processing pipeline for a single probe. Orchestrates the sequence: (1) Find valid trials based on conditions, (2) Find clusters by quality, (3) Align spikes to a reference event, (4) Generate PSTHs and single-trial data, (5) Remove low-firing-rate units, (6) Calculate baseline firing rate statistics during presample period.\\n\\n---\\n\\n### 4. **findTrials.m**\\n**Full Content:**\\n```matlab\\nfunction trialNums = findTrials(obj, conditions)\\n\\n% % older data objects have obj.bp.autowater.nums\\n% % newer data objects do not (from summer2021 pipeline)\\n% if ~isfield(obj.bp.autowater, 'nums')\\n%     tmp = obj.bp.autowater;\\n%     obj.bp = rmfield(obj.bp, 'autowater');\\n%     obj.bp.autowater.nums = tmp + (tmp-1)*-2;\\n% end\\n\\nvarnames = getStructVarNames(obj);\\nNtrials = obj.bp.Ntrials;\\nfor i = 1:numel(varnames)\\n    eval([varnames{i} ' = obj.bp.' varnames{i} ';']);\\n    \\n    if eval(['numel(' varnames{i} ')==obj.bp.Ntrials && isrow(' varnames{i} ')'])\\n        eval([varnames{i} '=' varnames{i} ''';']);\\n    end\\n    \\n    eval([varnames{i} '=' varnames{i} '(~isnan(' varnames{i} '))' ''';'])\\nend\\n\\nif isfield (obj.bp, 'fidx')\\n    obj.bp.Ntrials = sum(obj.bp.fidx==2);\\n    addToTrialNums = sum(obj.bp.fidx==1);\\nend\\n\\nmask = zeros(obj.bp.Ntrials, numel(conditions));\\n\\nfor i = 1:numel(conditions)\\n    try\\n        mask(:,i) = eval(conditions{i});\\n    catch\\n        mask(:,i) = eval(conditions{i}{1});\\n    end\\n    if exist('addToTrialNums','var') == 1\\n        trialNums{i} = find(mask(:,i)) + addToTrialNums;\\n    else\\n        trialNums{i} = find(mask(:,i));\\n    end\\nend\\n\\nend % findTrials\\n```\\n\\n**Summary:** Filters trials based on condition strings (stored in obj.bp). For each condition, evaluates logical expressions on behavioral variables (hit, miss, R, L, stim.enable, autowater, early, etc.) and returns trial indices matching each condition. Handles a fidx field for distinguishing early vs. valid lick trials.\\n\\n---\\n\\n### 5. **findClusters.m**\\n**Full Content:**\\n```matlab\\nfunction idx = findClusters(qualityList, qualities)\\n% find idx where qualityList contains at least one of the patterns in\\n% qualities\\n\\n% remove leading/trailing spaces\\n% also check if each entry in qualityList is a string/char, if not, change\\n% it\\nfor i = 1:numel(qualityList)\\n    if ~ischar(qualityList{i}) && ~isstring(qualityList{i})\\n        qualityList{i} = '';\\n    end\\nend\\nqualityList = strtrim(qualityList);\\n\\nif any(strcmpi(qualities,'all')) || strcmpi(qualities{1},'all')\\n    idx = find(~ismember(qualityList,'garbage') & ~ismember(qualityList,'gabrga') & ~ismember(qualityList,'noisy') & ~ismember(qualityList,'real?'));\\n%     idx = 1:numel(qualityList);\\n    return\\nend\\n\\n% handle unlabeled cluster qualities\\nfor i = 1:numel(qualityList)\\n    if isempty(qualityList{i})\\n        qualityList(i) = {'nan'};\\n    end\\n%     qualityList(i) = lower(qualityList(i));\\nend\\n\\n[~,mask] = patternMatchCellArray(qualityList, qualities, 'any');\\n\\nidx = find(mask);\\nend % findClusters\\n```\\n\\n**Summary:** Filters units by quality. When quality='all', returns all clusters except those labeled 'garbage', 'garba', 'noisy', or 'real?'. Otherwise uses pattern matching to find clusters matching specified quality labels.\\n\\n---\\n\\n### 6. **alignSpikes.m**\\n**Full Content:**\\n```matlab\\nfunction obj = alignSpikes(obj,params,prbnum)\\n\\nif strcmp(params.alignEvent,'moveOnset')\\n    obj.bp.ev.(params.alignEvent) = findMoveOnset(obj);\\nend\\n\\nif strcmp(params.alignEvent,'firstLick')\\n    % get first lick time for left and right licks\\n    temp = obj.bp.ev.lickL;\\n    idx = ~cellfun('isempty',temp);\\n    outL = zeros(size(temp));\\n    outL(idx) = cellfun(@(v)v(1),temp(idx));\\n    temp = obj.bp.ev.lickR;\\n    idx = ~cellfun('isempty',temp);\\n    outR = zeros(size(temp));\\n    outR(idx) = cellfun(@(v)v(1),temp(idx));\\n    firstLick = zeros(size(temp));\\n    % firstLick = min(outL,outR), except when outL||outR == 0\\n    outL(outL==0) = nan;\\n    outR(outR==0) = nan;\\n    firstLick = nanmin(outL,outR);\\n    firstLick(isnan(firstLick)) = 0;\\n    obj.bp.ev.(params.alignEvent) = firstLick;\\nend\\nif strcmp(params.alignEvent,'lastLick')\\n    % get last lick time for left and right licks\\n    temp = obj.bp.ev.lickL;\\n    idx = ~cellfun('isempty',temp);\\n    outL = zeros(size(temp));\\n    outL(idx) = cellfun(@(v)v(end),temp(idx));\\n    temp = obj.bp.ev.lickR;\\n    idx = ~cellfun('isempty',temp);\\n    outR = zeros(size(temp));\\n    outR(idx) = cellfun(@(v)v(end),temp(idx));\\n    lastLick = zeros(size(temp));\\n    % lastLick = max(outL,outR), except when outL||outR == 0\\n    outL(outL==0) = nan;\\n    outR(outR==0) = nan;\\n    lastLick = nanmax(outL,outR);\\n    lastLick(isnan(lastLick)) = 0;\\n    obj.bp.ev.(params.alignEvent) = lastLick;\\nend\\n\\nif strcmp(params.alignEvent,'jawOnset')\\n    % half rise time to first peak of jaw onset after go cue\\n    view = 1; % side cam\\n    [~,jawMask] = patternMatchCellArray(obj.traj{view}(1).featNames,{'jaw'},'all');\\n    feat = find(jawMask); % jaw\\n\\n    % filter params\\n    opts.f_cut = 60; % cutoff freq for butter filt\\n    opts.f_n   = 2;  % filter order\\n\\n    % peak finding params\\n    opts.minpkdist = 0.06; % number of ms around peaks to reject peaks\\n    opts.minpkprom = 10;   % a threshold for the peak size\\n    obj.bp.ev.(params.alignEvent) = alignJawOnset(view,feat,obj,opts);\\nend\\n\\n% align spikes to params.alignEvent\\nfor clu = 1:numel(obj.clu{prbnum})\\n    event = obj.bp.ev.(params.alignEvent)(obj.clu{prbnum}(clu).trial);\\n\\n    obj.clu{prbnum}(clu).trialtm_aligned = obj.clu{prbnum}(clu).trialtm - event;\\nend\\n\\nend % alignSpikes\\n```\\n\\n**Summary:** Re-references spike times relative to an alignment event. Handles multiple event types: goCue (already in obj), moveOnset (extracted via findMoveOnset), firstLick/lastLick (computed as minimum/maximum of left/right lick times), and jawOnset (detected via video processing). For each cluster on the specified probe, subtracts the event time from spike times within each trial.\\n\\n---\\n\\n### 7. **getSeq.m**\\n**Full Content:**\\n```matlab\\nfunction obj = getSeq(obj,params,prbnum,varargin)\\n\\nif isfield(obj,'psth')\\n    obj = rmfield(obj,{'psth','trialdat'});\\nend\\n\\nif nargin > 3\\n    doPSTH = varargin{1};\\nelse\\n    doPSTH = true;\\nend\\n\\nedges = params.tmin:params.dt:params.tmax;\\nobj.time = edges + params.dt/2;\\nobj.time = obj.time(1:end-1);\\n\\nspkedges = params.tmin:0.001:params.tmax;\\n\\n% get psths by condition\\nobj.psth{prbnum} = zeros(numel(obj.time),numel(params.cluid{prbnum}),numel(params.condition));\\nif doPSTH\\n    for i = 1:numel(params.cluid{prbnum})\\n        curClu = params.cluid{prbnum}(i);\\n        for j = 1:numel(params.condition)\\n\\n            trix = params.trialid{j};\\n\\n            spkix = ismember(obj.clu{prbnum}(curClu).trial, trix);\\n\\n\\n            % if no spikes found for current set of trials (trix), move on to\\n            % next set\\n            if all(~spkix)\\n                continue\\n            end\\n\\n\\n            N = histc(obj.clu{prbnum}(curClu).trialtm_aligned(spkix), edges);\\n            N = N(1:end-1);\\n\\n            obj.psth{prbnum}(:,i,j) = mySmooth(N./numel(trix)./params.dt, params.smooth, params.bctype);  % trial-averaged separated by trial type\\n\\n        end\\n    end\\nend\\n\\n\\n% get single trial data\\nobj.trialdat{prbnum} = zeros(numel(obj.time),numel(params.cluid{prbnum}),obj.bp.Ntrials);\\n% obj.trialspikes{prbnum} = zeros(numel(spkedges),numel(params.cluid{prbnum}),obj.bp.Ntrials);\\nfor i = 1:numel(params.cluid{prbnum})\\n    curClu = params.cluid{prbnum}(i);\\n    for j = 1:obj.bp.Ntrials\\n\\n        spkix = ismember(obj.clu{prbnum}(curClu).trial, j);\\n\\n        % if no spikes found for current trial (j), move on to\\n        % next trial\\n        if all(~spkix)\\n            continue\\n        end\\n\\n\\n        N = histc(obj.clu{prbnum}(curClu).trialtm_aligned(spkix), edges);\\n        N = N(1:end-1);\\n        if size(N,2) > size(N,1)\\n            N = N'; % make sure N is a column vector\\n        end\\n\\n\\n        obj.trialdat{prbnum}(:,i,j) = mySmooth(N./params.dt,params.smooth, params.bctype);\\n\\n        %         % raw spikes\\n        %         spkN = histc(obj.clu{prbnum}(curClu).trialtm_aligned(spkix), spkedges);\\n        %         if size(spkN,2) > size(spkN,1)\\n        %             spkN = spkN'; % make sure N is a column vector\\n        %         end\\n        %         spkN(spkN > 1) = 1; % binarize (should only have at most 1 spk in 1 ms bin)\\n        %         obj.trialspikes{prbnum}(:,i,j) = spkN;\\n\\n    end\\nend\\n\\nend % getSeq\\n```\\n\\n**Summary:** Creates binned, smoothed spike data at two levels: (1) PSTH (trial-averaged per condition) with dimensions [time × units × conditions], (2) Single-trial data with dimensions [time × units × trials]. Uses histogram binning with bin width params.dt (default 5ms), normalized by trial count and bin width to get firing rate (spikes/sec). Smooths with Gaussian kernel (params.smooth=15ms) and applies boundary condition handling. Time axis spans params.tmin to params.tmax (default -2.5 to +2.5 sec).\\n\\n---\\n\\n### 8. **getDefaultParams.m**\\n**Full Content:**\\n```matlab\\nfunction params = getDefaultParams()\\n\\nparams.alignEvent          = 'goCue';        % error right, no stim, aw off\\n% params.condition(end+1) = {'L&miss&~stim.enable&~autowater&~early'};        % error left, no stim, aw off\\n% params.condition(end+1) = {'~hit&~miss&~stim.enable&~autowater&~early'}; Includes video feature lists and epoch definitions (prep: -2.5 to -0.05 sec; move: -2.5 to +1.5 sec).\\n\\n---\\n\\n### 9. **baselineFR.m**\\n**Full Content:**\\n```matlab\\nfunction [presampleFR, presampleSigma] = baselineFR(obj,params,prbnum)\\n\\n% baselineFR - (nCells,nTrialTypes) mean FR for each clu and tt\\n\\nedges = -0.5:params.dt:mode(obj.bp.ev.sample);\\ntime = edges + params.dt/2;\\ntime = time(1:end-1);\\n\\n% get psths by condition\\npsth = zeros(numel(time),numel(params.cluid{prbnum}),numel(params.condition));\\nfor i = 1:numel(params.cluid{prbnum})\\n    curClu = params.cluid{prbnum}(i);\\n    for j = 1:numel(params.condition)\\n        trix = params.trialid{j};\\n        spkix = ismember(obj.clu{prbnum}(curClu).trial, trix);\\n\\n        N = histc(obj.clu{prbnum}(curClu).trialtm(spkix), edges);\\n        N = N(1:end-1);\\n\\n        psth(:,i,j) = mySmooth(N./numel(trix)./params.dt, params.smooth);  % trial-averaged separated by trial type\\n    end\\nend\\n\\npresampleFR = squeeze(median(psth,1));\\npresampleSigma = squeeze(std(psth,[],1));\\n\\nend\\n```\\n\\n**Summary:** Calculates baseline firing rate statistics during the presample epoch (from -0.5 sec to sample event time). For each cluster and condition, bins spikes with smoothing. Returns median firing rate and standard deviation across time points, resulting in arrays of shape [nUnits × nConditions]. Used for baseline normalization.\\n\\n---\\n\\n### 10. **removeLowFRClusters.m**\\n**Full Content:**\\n```matlab\\nfunction [obj,cluid] = removeLowFRClusters(obj,cluid,lowFR,prbnum)\\n% % Remove low-firing rate units, e.g., all those firing less than lowFR\\n%   spikes per second on average across all trials.\\n%   \\n%   The fitted observation noise (diagonal element of R) for a\\n%   low-firing rate unit will be small, so the neural trajectory may\\n%   show a deflection each time the neuron spikes.\\n\\nmeanFRs = mean(mean(obj.psth{prbnum},3,'omitnan'),'omitnan');\\nuse = meanFRs > lowFR;\\n\\n% remove low fr clusters\\ncluid = cluid(use);\\nobj.psth{prbnum} = obj.psth{prbnum}(:,use,:);\\nobj.trialdat{prbnum} = obj.trialdat{prbnum}(:,use,:);\\n\\nend % removeLowFRClusters\\n```\\n\\n**Summary:** Filters out units with mean firing rate below the lowFR threshold (default 0.5 Hz, can be set to 1 Hz). Computes mean firing rate by averaging the PSTH across time and conditions. Include unlabeled units (matching MATLAB 'all' behavior which includes empty strings)\\n            indices.append(i)\\n    return indices\\n\\n\\ndef align_and_bin_spikes(clusters, cluster_indices, go_cue_times, trial_mask,\\n                         edges, dt, smooth_samples):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Align spikes to goCue, bin, smooth, and compute firing rates.\\n\\n    Returns:\\n        trialdat: (n_timebins, n_units, n_trials) firing rate array\\n        mean_frs: (n_units,) mean firing rate per unit\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    valid_trials = np.where(trial_mask)[0]\\n    n_trials = len(valid_trials)\\n    n_units = len(cluster_indices)\\n    n_timebins = len(edges) - 1\\n\\n    trialdat = np.zeros((n_timebins, n_units, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n    for ui, ci in enumerate(cluster_indices):\\n        unit = clusters[ci]\\n        spike_times = unit['trialtm']\\n        spike_trials = unit['trial']\\n\\n        for ti, trial_idx in enumerate(valid_trials):\\n            trial_num = trial_idx + 1  # MATLAB 1-indexed\\n            go_time = go_cue_times[trial_idx]\\n\\n            if np.isnan(go_time) or go_time == 0:\\n                continue\\n\\n            # Find spikes for this trial\\n            spike_mask = spike_trials == trial_num\\n            if not np.any(spike_mask):\\n                continue\\n\\n            # Align to go cue\\n            aligned_times = spike_times[spike_mask] - go_time\\n\\n            # Bin spikes\\n            counts, _ = np.histogram(aligned_times, bins=edges)\\n            counts = counts[:n_timebins].astype(float)\\n\\n            # Convert to firing rate and smooth\\n            fr = counts / dt\\n            fr_smooth = causal_gaussian_smooth(fr, smooth_samples)\\n            trialdat[:, ui, ti] = fr_smooth\\n\\n    # Compute mean firing rate per unit (across all trials and time)\\n    # Matching removeLowFRClusters.m: mean of mean across conditions\\n    # For simplicity, use mean across all time and trials\\n    mean_frs = np.mean(np.mean(trialdat, axis=2), axis=0)\\n\\n    return trialdat, mean_frs\\n\\n\\ndef compute_velocity(positions, dt_video=1/400):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute velocity magnitude from x,y positions.\\n\\n    positions: (n_frames, 2) array of [x, y]\\n    Returns: (n_frames,) velocity magnitude\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if positions is None or len(positions) < 2:\\n        return None\\n\\n    # Compute velocity as first derivative\\n    dx = np.gradient(positions[:, 0], dt_video)\\n    dy = np.gradient(positions[:, 1], dt_video)\\n    velocity = np.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2)\\n    return velocity\\n\\n\\ndef extract_kinematic_feature(session, cam_idx, feat_name, valid_trials, go_cue_times):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Extract and interpolate a kinematic feature velocity to neural time axis.\\n\\n    Returns:\\n        velocities: (n_timebins, n_trials) array or None\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if cam_idx >= len(session['traj']):\\n        return None\\n\\n    cam = session['traj'][cam_idx]\\n    feat_names = [fn.lower() for fn in cam['feat_names']]\\n\\n    # Find feature index\\n    feat_idx = None\\n    for i, fn in enumerate(feat_names):\\n        if feat_name.lower() in fn:\\n            feat_idx = i\\n            break\\n\\n    if feat_idx is None:\\n        return None\\n\\n    vidshift = session.get('vidshift', 0.0)\\n    n_trials = len(valid_trials)\\n    velocities = np.full((N_TIMEBINS, n_trials), np.nan, dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n    for ti, trial_idx in enumerate(valid_trials):\\n        if trial_idx >= len(cam['trials']):\\n            continue\\n\\n        trial_data = cam['trials'][trial_idx]\\n        ts = trial_data.get('ts')\\n        frame_times = trial_data.get('frameTimes')\\n\\n        if ts is None:\\n            continue\\n\\n        # Handle NdroppedFrames\\n        if np.isnan(trial_data.get('NdroppedFrames', 0)):\\n            continue\\n\\n        go_time = go_cue_times[trial_idx]\\n        if np.isnan(go_time) or go_time == 0:\\n            continue\\n\\n        # ts shape from HDF5: may be transposed\\n        # In MATLAB: ts(n_frames, 3, n_features) where 3=[x,y,likelihood]\\n        # In HDF5 (column-major): could be (n_features, 3, n_frames)\\n        if ts.ndim == 3:\\n            # Try to figure out the right shape\\n            # The 3 should be [x, y, likelihood]\\n            if ts.shape[0] == 3:\\n                # (3, n_features, n_frames) -> need (n_frames, 3, n_features)\\n                ts = np.transpose(ts, (2, 0, 1))\\n            elif ts.shape[1] == 3:\\n                # (n_features, 3, n_frames) -> need (n_frames, 3, n_features)\\n                ts = np.transpose(ts, (2, 1, 0))\\n            elif ts.shape[2] == 3:\\n                # Already (n_frames, n_features, 3) -> need (n_frames, 3, n_features)\\n                ts = np.transpose(ts, (0, 2, 1))\\n\\n            n_frames = ts.shape[0]\\n            if feat_idx >= ts.shape[2]:\\n                continue\\n\\n            # Extract x, y for the feature\\n            xy = ts[:, :2, feat_idx]  # (n_frames, 2)\\n        else:\\n            continue\\n\\n        # Fill missing values (nearest) for non-tongue features\\n        if 'tongue' not in feat_name.lower():\\n            for col in range(2):\\n                mask = np.isnan(xy[:, col])\\n                if mask.any() and not mask.all():\\n                    valid_idx = np.where(~mask)[0]\\n                    xy[mask, col] = np.interp(\\n                        np.where(mask)[0], valid_idx, xy[valid_idx, col]\\n                    )\\n\\n        # Compute velocity\\n        vel = compute_velocity(xy, 1/400)\\n        if vel is None:\\n            continue\\n\\n        # Create frame times if not available\\n        if frame_times is None or np.all(np.isnan(frame_times)):\\n            frame_times = np.arange(1, n_frames + 1) / 400.0\\n\\n        # Align to go cue and interpolate to neural time axis\\n        aligned_frame_times = frame_times - vidshift - go_time\\n\\n        try:\\n            interp_fn = interp1d(aligned_frame_times, vel,\\n                                kind='linear', bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan)\\n            velocities[:, ti] = interp_fn(TIME_AXIS)\\n        except:\\n            continue\\n\\n    # Fill NaN with nearest valid values\\n    for ti in range(n_trials):\\n        col = velocities[:, ti]\\n        mask = np.isnan(col)\\n        if mask.any() and not mask.all():\\n            valid_idx = np.where(~mask)[0]\\n            col[mask] = np.interp(np.where(mask)[0], valid_idx, col[valid_idx])\\n            velocities[:, ti] = col\\n        elif mask.all():\\n            velocities[:, ti] = 0.0\\n\\n    return velocities\\n\\n\\ndef interpolate_motion_energy(me_data, session, valid_trials, go_cue_times):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Interpolate motion energy to neural time axis, aligned to go cue.\\n\\n    Matching loadMotionEnergy.m logic.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    vidshift = session.get('vidshift', 0.0)\\n    n_trials = len(valid_trials)\\n    me_interp = np.full((N_TIMEBINS, n_trials), np.nan, dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n    for ti, trial_idx in enumerate(valid_trials):\\n        if trial_idx >= len(me_data):\\n            continue\\n\\n        me_trial = me_data[trial_idx]\\n        go_time = go_cue_times[trial_idx]\\n\\n        if np.isnan(go_time) or go_time == 0:\\n            continue\\n\\n        if me_trial is None or len(me_trial) == 0:\\n            continue\\n\\n        n_frames = len(me_trial)\\n\\n        # Get frame times\\n        # Try to use traj frameTimes, otherwise fall back\\n        frame_times = None\\n        if len(session['traj']) > 0 and trial_idx < len(session['traj'][0]['trials']):\\n            ft = session['traj'][0]['trials'][trial_idx].get('frameTimes')\\n            if ft is not None and not np.all(np.isnan(ft)):\\n                frame_times = ft\\n\\n        if frame_times is None:\\n            frame_times = np.arange(1, n_frames + 1) / 400.0\\n            aligned_frame_times = frame_times - 0.5 - go_time  # fallback offset\\n        else:\\n            # Trim/pad to match me_trial length\\n            if len(frame_times) > n_frames:\\n                frame_times = frame_times[:n_frames]\\n            elif len(frame_times) < n_frames:\\n                # Extend frame times\\n                dt_vid = 1/400\\n                extra = np.arange(len(frame_times), n_frames) * dt_vid + frame_times[-1] + dt_vid\\n                frame_times = np.concatenate([frame_times, extra])\\n            aligned_frame_times = frame_times - vidshift - go_time\\n\\n        try:\\n            interp_fn = interp1d(aligned_frame_times, me_trial,\\n                                kind='linear', bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan)\\n            me_interp[:, ti] = interp_fn(TIME_AXIS)\\n        except:\\n            continue\\n\\n    # Fill NaN with nearest\\n    for ti in range(n_trials):\\n        col = me_interp[:, ti]\\n        mask = np.isnan(col)\\n        if mask.any() and not mask.all():\\n            valid_idx = np.where(~mask)[0]\\n            col[mask] = np.interp(np.where(mask)[0], valid_idx, col[valid_idx])\\n            me_interp[:, ti] = col\\n        elif mask.all():\\n            me_interp[:, ti] = 0.0\\n\\n    return me_interp\\n\\n\\ndef discretize_per_session(values, percentile=50):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Discretize values into 2 bins using per-session threshold.\\n\\n    values: (n_timebins, n_trials)\\n    Returns: (n_timebins, n_trials) with 0 (< threshold) and 1 (>= threshold)\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    # Compute threshold across all valid values\\n    valid = values[~np.isnan(values)]\\n    if len(valid) == 0:\\n        return np.zeros_like(values, dtype=np.int32)\\n\\n    threshold = np.percentile(valid, percentile)\\n    discretized = (values >= threshold).astype(np.int32)\\n    return discretized\\n\\n\\ndef process_session(session_file, me_file, session_idx_global):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Process a single session and return formatted data.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    basename = os.path.basename(session_file)\\n    parts = basename.replace('data_structure_', '').replace('.mat', '').split('_')\\n    animal = parts[0]\\n    date = '_'.join(parts[1:])\\n\\n    print(f\\\"\\\\n--- Processing session {session_idx_global}: {animal}_{date} ---\\\")\\n\\n    # Load session data\\n    session = load_session_data(session_file)\\n    Ntrials = session['Ntrials']\\n    print(f\\\"  Total trials: {Ntrials}\\\")\\n\\n    # Load motion energy\\n    me = load_motion_energy(me_file) if me_file else None\\n\\n    # --- Trial filtering ---\\n    # Include: non-stim, non-early, responding (hit or miss) trials\\n    # Matching: ~stim.enable & ~early & (hit | miss)\\n    trial_mask = (\\n        (session['stim_enable'] == 0) &\\n        (session['early'] == 0) &\\n        ((session['hit'] == 1) | (session['miss'] == 1))\\n    )\\n\\n    valid_trials = np.where(trial_mask)[0]\\n    n_valid = len(valid_trials)\\n    print(f\\\"  Valid trials (no stim, no early, hit|miss): {n_valid}\\\")\\n\\n    if n_valid < 2:\\n        print(f\\\"  SKIPPING: fewer than 2 valid trials\\\")\\n        return None\\n\\n    # --- Cluster filtering and spike processing ---\\n    # Process all probes\\n    all_cluster_indices = []\\n    all_clusters = []\\n    probe_region_labels = []\\n\\n    for probe_idx in range(session['n_probes']):\\n        clusters = session['clusters'][probe_idx]\\n\\n        # Get probe location\\n        if probe_idx < len(session['probe_locations']):\\n            loc = session['probe_locations'][probe_idx]\\n        else:\\n            loc = 'ALM'\\n\\n        # Filter by quality (matching findClusters.m with quality='all')\\n        valid_units = filter_clusters(clusters)\\n\\n        if len(valid_units) == 0:\\n            continue\\n\\n        # Compute firing rates for this probe\\n        trialdat_probe, mean_frs = align_and_bin_spikes(\\n            clusters, valid_units, session['goCue'], trial_mask,\\n            EDGES, DT, SMOOTH_MS\\n        )\\n\\n        # Filter by firing rate (matching removeLowFRClusters.m)\\n        fr_mask = mean_frs > LOW_FR\\n        kept_units = [valid_units[i] for i in range(len(valid_units)) if fr_mask[i]]\\n        trialdat_probe = trialdat_probe[:, fr_mask, :]\\n\\n        print(f\\\"  Probe {probe_idx} ({loc}): {len(clusters)} total -> {len(valid_units)} quality-filtered -> {len(kept_units)} FR-filtered units\\\")\\n\\n        all_clusters.append(trialdat_probe)\\n        for _ in kept_units:\\n            probe_region_labels.append(loc)\\n\\n    if len(all_clusters) == 0:\\n        print(f\\\"  SKIPPING: no valid clusters\\\")\\n        return None\\n\\n    # Concatenate across probes: (n_timebins, n_total_units, n_trials)\\n    neural_data = np.concatenate(all_clusters, axis=1)\\n    n_units = neural_data.shape[1]\\n    n_trials = neural_data.shape[2]\\n    print(f\\\"  Neural data shape: {neural_data.shape} (time, units, trials)\\\")\\n\\n    if n_units == 0:\\n        print(f\\\"  SKIPPING: 0 valid units after filtering\\\")\\n        return None\\n\\n    # --- Extract behavioral variables ---\\n    lick_direction = session['R'][valid_trials].astype(np.int32)  # R=1, L=0\\n    context = (1 - session['autowater'][valid_trials]).astype(np.int32)  # DR=1, WC=0\\n    outcome = session['hit'][valid_trials].astype(np.int32)  # correct=1, incorrect=0\\n\\n    print(f\\\"  Lick direction: R={np.sum(lick_direction==1)}, L={np.sum(lick_direction==0)}\\\")\\n    print(f\\\"  Context: DR={np.sum(context==1)}, WC={np.sum(context==0)}\\\")\\n    print(f\\\"  Outcome: correct={np.sum(outcome==1)}, incorrect={np.sum(outcome==0)}\\\")\\n\\n    # --- Extract kinematic features ---\\n    go_cue_times = session['goCue']\\n\\n    # Tongue velocity from side camera (cam 0), feature 'tongue'\\n    tongue_vel = extract_kinematic_feature(session, 0, 'tongue', valid_trials, go_cue_times)\\n\\n    # Paw velocity from bottom camera (cam 1)\\n    paw_vel = None\\n    if len(session['traj']) > 1:\\n        # Try top_paw first, then bottom_paw\\n        paw_vel = extract_kinematic_feature(session, 1, 'top_paw', valid_trials, go_cue_times)\\n        if paw_vel is None:\\n            paw_vel = extract_kinematic_feature(session, 1, 'bottom_paw', valid_trials, go_cue_times)\\n\\n        # If we got one paw, try to average with the other\\n        if paw_vel is not None:\\n            paw_vel2 = extract_kinematic_feature(session, 1, 'bottom_paw', valid_trials, go_cue_times)\\n            if paw_vel2 is not None:\\n                paw_vel = (paw_vel + paw_vel2) / 2.0\\n\\n    # Motion energy\\n    me_interp = None\\n    if me is not None:\\n        me_interp = interpolate_motion_energy(me['data'], session, valid_trials, go_cue_times)\\n\\n    # --- Discretize continuous outputs ---\\n    if tongue_vel is not None:\\n        tongue_vel_disc = discretize_per_session(tongue_vel)\\n    else:\\n        print(f\\\"  Warning: No tongue velocity data, using zeros\\\")\\n        tongue_vel_disc = np.zeros((N_TIMEBINS, n_trials), dtype=np.int32)\\n\\n    if paw_vel is not None:\\n        paw_vel_disc = discretize_per_session(paw_vel)\\n    else:\\n        print(f\\\"  Warning: No paw velocity data, using zeros\\\")\\n        paw_vel_disc = np.zeros((N_TIMEBINS, n_trials), dtype=np.int32)\\n\\n    if me_interp is not None:\\n        me_disc = discretize_per_session(me_interp)\\n    else:\\n        print(f\\\"  Warning: No motion energy data, using zeros\\\")\\n        me_disc = np.zeros((N_TIMEBINS, n_trials), dtype=np.int32)\\n\\n    # --- Format per-trial data ---\\n    neural_trials = []\\n    input_trials = []\\n    output_trials = []\\n\\n    for ti in range(n_trials):\\n        # Neural: (n_units, n_timebins)\\n        neural_trial = neural_data[:, :, ti].T.astype(np.float32)\\n        neural_trials.append(neural_trial)\\n\\n        # Input: time from go cue (1, n_timebins)\\n        input_trial = TIME_AXIS.reshape(1, -1).astype(np.float32)\\n        input_trials.append(input_trial)\\n\\n        # Output: (6, n_timebins) - per-trial values tiled, time-varying ones as-is\\n        output_trial = np.zeros((6, N_TIMEBINS), dtype=np.int32)\\n        output_trial[0, :] = lick_direction[ti]  # per-trial\\n        output_trial[1, :] = context[ti]  # per-trial\\n        output_trial[2, :] = outcome[ti]  # per-trial\\n        output_trial[3, :] = tongue_vel_disc[:, ti]  # time-varying\\n        output_trial[4, :] = paw_vel_disc[:, ti]  # time-varying\\n        output_trial[5, :] = me_disc[:, ti]  # time-varying\\n        output_trials.append(output_trial)\\n\\n    # --- Brain region info ---\\n    # Clean up region labels\\n    region_labels_clean = []\\n    for label in probe_region_labels:\\n        label_clean = label.strip()\\n        # Normalize common variations\\n        if 'ALM' in label_clean.upper():\\n            label_clean = 'ALM'\\n        elif 'TJM1' in label_clean.upper() or 'M1' in label_clean.upper():\\n            label_clean = 'tjM1'\\n        region_labels_clean.append(label_clean)\\n\\n    return {\\n        'neural': neural_trials,\\n        'input': input_trials,\\n        'output': output_trials,\\n        'animal': animal,\\n        'date': date,\\n        'region_labels': region_labels_clean,\\n        'n_units': n_units,\\n        'n_trials': n_trials,\\n    }\\n\\n\\ndef find_session_files(data_dirs):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Find all data_structure and motionEnergy file pairs.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    sessions = []\\n\\n    for data_dir in data_dirs:\\n        if not os.path.isdir(data_dir):\\n            continue\\n\\n        data_files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(data_dir, 'data_structure_*.mat')))\\n\\n        for df in data_files:\\n            basename = os.path.basename(df)\\n            # Extract animal_date from data_structure_ANIMAL_DATE.mat\\n            parts = basename.replace('data_structure_', '').replace('.mat', '')\\n            me_file = os.path.join(data_dir, f'motionEnergy_{parts}.mat')\\n\\n            if not os.path.exists(me_file):\\n                me_file = None\\n\\n            sessions.append({\\n                'data_file': df,\\n                'me_file': me_file,\\n                'animal_date': parts,\\n            })\\n\\n    return sessions\\n\\n\\ndef convert_data(data_dirs=DATA_DIRS, max_sessions=None, output_file='converted_data.pkl'):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Main conversion function.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    # Find all session files\\n    session_files = find_session_files(data_dirs)\\n    print(f\\\"Found {len(session_files)} sessions\\\")\\n\\n    if max_sessions is not None:\\n        session_files = session_files[:max_sessions]\\n        print(f\\\"Processing first {max_sessions} sessions\\\")\\n\\n    # Process each session\\n    all_neural = []\\n    all_input = []\\n    all_output = []\\n    all_animals = []\\n    all_dates = []\\n    all_region_labels = []\\n\\n    for idx, sf in enumerate(session_files):\\n        result = process_session(sf['data_file'], sf['me_file'], idx)\\n\\n        if result is None:\\n            continue\\n\\n        all_neural.append(result['neural'])\\n        all_input.append(result['input'])\\n        all_output.append(result['output'])\\n        all_animals.append(result['animal'])\\n        all_dates.append(result['date'])\\n        all_region_labels.append(result['region_labels'])\\n\\n    n_sessions = len(all_neural)\\n    print(f\\\"\\\\n=== Successfully processed {n_sessions} sessions ===\\\")\\n\\n    if n_sessions == 0:\\n        print(\\\"ERROR: No sessions processed successfully\\\")\\n        return None\\n\\n    # --- Build subject index ---\\n    unique_subjects = sorted(set(all_animals))\\n    subject_idx = np.array([unique_subjects.index(a) for a in all_animals], dtype=np.int64)\\n\\n    # --- Build brain region index ---\\n    all_regions_flat = set()\\n    for labels in all_region_labels:\\n        all_regions_flat.update(labels)\\n    brain_regions = sorted(all_regions_flat)\\n\\n    brain_region_idx = []\\n    for labels in all_region_labels:\\n        idx_arr = np.array([brain_regions.index(l) for l in labels], dtype=np.int64)\\n        brain_region_idx.append(idx_arr)\\n\\n    # --- Video offset computation ---\\n        # vidshift = mode(sglx.bitcode.bitstart) / sglx.fs - mode(bp.ev.bitStart)\\n        try:\\n            bitStart_bp = np.nanmedian(ev['bitStart'][()].flatten())\\n            sglx = obj['sglx']\\n            fs = h5_read_scalar(sglx['fs'])\\n            bitstart_sglx = np.nanmedian(sglx['bitcode']['bitstart'][()].flatten())\\n            session['vidshift'] = bitstart_sglx / fs - bitStart_bp\\n        except:\\n            session['vidshift'] = 0.0\\n\\n    return session\\n\\n\\ndef load_motion_energy(filepath):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Load motion energy from .mat file (v5/v7 format).\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    try:\\n        mat = scipy.io.loadmat(filepath, squeeze_me=False)\\n        me = mat['me']\\n\\n        # Extract data and threshold\\n        data_field = me['data'][0, 0]\\n        thresh_field = me['moveThresh'][0, 0]\\n\\n        # data is an object array with per-trial arrays\\n        me_data = []\\n        for i in range(data_field.shape[0]):\\n            for j in range(data_field.shape[1]):\\n                trial_me = data_field[i, j].flatten().astype(float)\\n                me_data.append(trial_me)\\n\\n        threshold = float(thresh_field.flatten()[0])\\n\\n        return {'data': me_data, 'moveThresh': threshold}\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        print(f\\\"  Warning: Could not load motion energy from {filepath}: {e}\\\")\\n        return None\\n\\n\\ndef filter_clusters(clusters, quality_filter='all'):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Filter clusters by quality, matching findClusters.m.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    excluded = {'garbage', 'gabrga', 'noisy', 'real?'}\\n    indices = []\\n    for i, unit in enumerate(clusters):\\n        q = unit.get('quality', '').strip().lower()\\n        if q not in excluded and q != '':\\n            indices.append(i)\\n        elif q == '':\\n            # Include unlabeled units (matching MATLAB 'all' behavior which includes empty strings)\\n            indices.append(i)\\n    return indices\\n\\n\\ndef align_and_bin_spikes(clusters, cluster_indices, go_cue_times, trial_mask,\\n                         edges, dt, smooth_samples):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Align spikes to goCue, bin, smooth, and compute firing rates.\\n\\n    Returns:\\n        trialdat: (n_timebins, n_units, n_trials) firing rate array\\n        mean_frs: (n_units,) mean firing rate per unit\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    valid_trials = np.where(trial_mask)[0]\\n    n_trials = len(valid_trials)\\n    n_units = len(cluster_indices)\\n    n_timebins = len(edges) - 1\\n\\n    trialdat = np.zeros((n_timebins, n_units, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n    for ui, ci in enumerate(cluster_indices):\\n        unit = clusters[ci]\\n        spike_times = unit['trialtm']\\n        spike_trials = unit['trial']\\n\\n        for ti, trial_idx in enumerate(valid_trials):\\n            trial_num = trial_idx + 1  # MATLAB 1-indexed\\n            go_time = go_cue_times[trial_idx]\\n\\n            if np.isnan(go_time) or go_time == 0:\\n                continue\\n\\n            # Find spikes for this trial\\n            spike_mask = spike_trials == trial_num\\n            if not np.any(spike_mask):\\n                continue\\n\\n            # Align to go cue\\n            aligned_times = spike_times[spike_mask] - go_time\\n\\n            # Bin spikes\\n            counts, _ = np.histogram(aligned_times, bins=edges)\\n            counts = counts[:n_timebins].astype(float)\\n\\n            # Convert to firing rate and smooth\\n            fr = counts / dt\\n            fr_smooth = causal_gaussian_smooth(fr, smooth_samples)\\n            trialdat[:, ui, ti] = fr_smooth\\n\\n    # Compute mean firing rate per unit (across all trials and time)\\n    # Matching removeLowFRClusters.m: mean of mean across conditions\\n    # For simplicity, use mean across all time and trials\\n    mean_frs = np.mean(np.mean(trialdat, axis=2), axis=0)\\n\\n    return trialdat, mean_frs\\n\\n\\ndef compute_velocity(positions, dt_video=1/400):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute velocity magnitude from x,y positions.\\n\\n    positions: (n_frames, 2) array of [x, y]\\n    Returns: (n_frames,) velocity magnitude\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if positions is None or len(positions) < 2:\\n        return None\\n\\n    # Compute velocity as first derivative\\n    dx = np.gradient(positions[:, 0], dt_video)\\n    dy = np.gradient(positions[:, 1], dt_video)\\n    velocity = np.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2)\\n    return velocity\\n\\n\\ndef extract_kinematic_feature(session, cam_idx, feat_name, valid_trials, go_cue_times):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Extract and interpolate a kinematic feature velocity to neural time axis.\\n\\n    Returns:\\n        velocities: (n_timebins, n_trials) array or None\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if cam_idx >= len(session['traj']):\\n        return None\\n\\n    cam = session['traj'][cam_idx]\\n    feat_names = [fn.lower() for fn in cam['feat_names']]\\n\\n    # Find feature index\\n    feat_idx = None\\n    for i, fn in enumerate(feat_names):\\n        if feat_name.lower() in fn:\\n            feat_idx = i\\n            break\\n\\n    if feat_idx is None:\\n        return None\\n\\n    vidshift = session.get('vidshift', 0.0)\\n    n_trials = len(valid_trials)\\n    velocities = np.full((N_TIMEBINS, n_trials), np.nan, dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n    for ti, trial_idx in enumerate(valid_trials):\\n        if trial_idx >= len(cam['trials']):\\n            continue\\n\\n        trial_data = cam['trials'][trial_idx]\\n        ts = trial_data.get('ts')\\n        frame_times = trial_data.get('frameTimes')\\n\\n        if ts is None:\\n            continue\\n\\n        # Handle NdroppedFrames\\n        if np.isnan(trial_data.get('NdroppedFrames', 0)):\\n            continue\\n\\n        go_time = go_cue_times[trial_idx]\\n        if np.isnan(go_time) or go_time == 0:\\n            continue\\n\\n        # ts shape from HDF5: may be transposed\\n        # In MATLAB: ts(n_frames, 3, n_features) where 3=[x,y,likelihood]\\n        # In HDF5 (column-major): could be (n_features, 3, n_frames)\\n        if ts.ndim == 3:\\n            # Try to figure out the right shape\\n            # The 3 should be [x, y, likelihood]\\n            if ts.shape[0] == 3:\\n                # (3, n_features, n_frames) -> need (n_frames, 3, n_features)\\n                ts = np.transpose(ts, (2, 0, 1))\\n            elif ts.shape[1] == 3:\\n                # (n_features, 3, n_frames) -> need (n_frames, 3, n_features)\\n                ts = np.transpose(ts, (2, 1, 0))\\n            elif ts.shape[2] == 3:\\n                # Already (n_frames, n_features, 3) -> need (n_frames, 3, n_features)\\n                ts = np.transpose(ts, (0, 2, 1))\\n\\n            n_frames = ts.shape[0]\\n            if feat_idx >= ts.shape[2]:\\n                continue\\n\\n            # Extract x, y for the feature\\n            xy = ts[:, :2, feat_idx]  # (n_frames, 2)\\n        else:\\n            continue\\n\\n        # Fill missing values (nearest) for non-tongue features\\n        if 'tongue' not in feat_name.lower():\\n            for col in range(2):\\n                mask = np.isnan(xy[:, col])\\n                if mask.any() and not mask.all():\\n                    valid_idx = np.where(~mask)[0]\\n                    xy[mask, col] = np.interp(\\n                        np.where(mask)[0], valid_idx, xy[valid_idx, col]\\n                    )\\n\\n        # Compute velocity\\n        vel = compute_velocity(xy, 1/400)\\n        if vel is None:\\n            continue\\n\\n        # Create frame times if not available\\n        if frame_times is None or np.all(np.isnan(frame_times)):\\n            frame_times = np.arange(1, n_frames + 1) / 400.0\\n\\n        # Align to go cue and interpolate to neural time axis\\n        aligned_frame_times = frame_times - vidshift - go_time\\n\\n        try:\\n            interp_fn = interp1d(aligned_frame_times, vel,\\n                                kind='linear', bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan)\\n            velocities[:, ti] = interp_fn(TIME_AXIS)\\n        except:\\n            continue\\n\\n    # Fill NaN with nearest valid values\\n    for ti in range(n_trials):\\n        col = velocities[:, ti]\\n        mask = np.isnan(col)\\n        if mask.any() and not mask.all():\\n            valid_idx = np.where(~mask)[0]\\n            col[mask] = np.interp(np.where(mask)[0], valid_idx, col[valid_idx])\\n            velocities[:, ti] = col\\n        elif mask.all():\\n            velocities[:, ti] = 0.0\\n\\n    return velocities\\n\\n\\ndef interpolate_motion_energy(me_data, session, valid_trials, go_cue_times):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Interpolate motion energy to neural time axis, aligned to go cue.\\n\\n    Matching loadMotionEnergy.m logic.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    vidshift = session.get('vidshift', 0.0)\\n    n_trials = len(valid_trials)\\n    me_interp = np.full((N_TIMEBINS, n_trials), np.nan, dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n    for ti, trial_idx in enumerate(valid_trials):\\n        if trial_idx >= len(me_data):\\n            continue\\n\\n        me_trial = me_data[trial_idx]\\n        go_time = go_cue_times[trial_idx]\\n\\n        if np.isnan(go_time) or go_time == 0:\\n            continue\\n\\n        if me_trial is None or len(me_trial) == 0:\\n            continue\\n\\n        n_frames = len(me_trial)\\n\\n        # Get frame times\\n        # Try to use traj frameTimes, otherwise fall back\\n        frame_times = None\\n        if len(session['traj']) > 0 and trial_idx < len(session['traj'][0]['trials']):\\n            ft = session['traj'][0]['trials'][trial_idx].get('frameTimes')\\n            if ft is not None and not np.all(np.isnan(ft)):\\n                frame_times = ft\\n\\n        if frame_times is None:\\n            frame_times = np.arange(1, n_frames + 1) / 400.0\\n            aligned_frame_times = frame_times - 0.5 - go_time  # fallback offset\\n        else:\\n            # Trim/pad to match me_trial length\\n            if len(frame_times) > n_frames:\\n                frame_times = frame_times[:n_frames]\\n            elif len(frame_times) < n_frames:\\n                # Extend frame times\\n                dt_vid = 1/400\\n                extra = np.arange(len(frame_times), n_frames) * dt_vid + frame_times[-1] + dt_vid\\n                frame_times = np.concatenate([frame_times, extra])\\n            aligned_frame_times = frame_times - vidshift - go_time\\n\\n        try:\\n            interp_fn = interp1d(aligned_frame_times, me_trial,\\n                                kind='linear', bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan)\\n            me_interp[:, ti] = interp_fn(TIME_AXIS)\\n        except:\\n            continue\\n\\n    # Fill NaN with nearest\\n    for ti in range(n_trials):\\n        col = me_interp[:, ti]\\n        mask = np.isnan(col)\\n        if mask.any() and not mask.all():\\n            valid_idx = np.where(~mask)[0]\\n            col[mask] = np.interp(np.where(mask)[0], valid_idx, col[valid_idx])\\n            me_interp[:, ti] = col\\n        elif mask.all():\\n            me_interp[:, ti] = 0.0\\n\\n    return me_interp\\n\\n\\ndef discretize_per_session(values, percentile=50):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Discretize values into 2 bins using per-session threshold.\\n\\n    values: (n_timebins, n_trials)\\n    Returns: (n_timebins, n_trials) with 0 (< threshold) and 1 (>= threshold)\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    # Compute threshold across all valid values\\n    valid = values[~np.isnan(values)]\\n    if len(valid) == 0:\\n        return np.zeros_like(values, dtype=np.int32)\\n\\n    threshold = np.percentile(valid, percentile)\\n    discretized = (values >= threshold).astype(np.int32)\\n    return discretized\\n\\n\\ndef process_session(session_file, me_file, session_idx_global):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Process a single session and return formatted data.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    basename = os.path.basename(session_file)\\n    parts = basename.replace('data_structure_', '').replace('.mat', '').split('_')\\n    animal = parts[0]\\n    date = '_'.join(parts[1:])\\n\\n    print(f\\\"\\\\n--- Processing session {session_idx_global}: {animal}_{date} ---\\\")\\n\\n    # Load session data\\n    session = load_session_data(session_file)\\n    Ntrials = session['Ntrials']\\n    print(f\\\"  Total trials: {Ntrials}\\\")\\n\\n    # Load motion energy\\n    me = load_motion_energy(me_file) if me_file else None\\n\\n    # --- Trial filtering ---\\n    # Include: non-stim, non-early, responding (hit or miss) trials\\n    # Matching: ~stim.enable & ~early & (hit | miss)\\n    trial_mask = (\\n        (session['stim_enable'] == 0) &\\n        (session['early'] == 0) &\\n        ((session['hit'] == 1) | (session['miss'] == 1))\\n    )\\n\\n    valid_trials = np.where(trial_mask)[0]\\n    n_valid = len(valid_trials)\\n    print(f\\\"  Valid trials (no stim, no early, hit|miss): {n_valid}\\\")\\n\\n    if n_valid < 2:\\n        print(f\\\"  SKIPPING: fewer than 2 valid trials\\\")\\n        return None\\n\\n    # --- Cluster filtering and spike processing ---\\n    # Process all probes\\n    all_cluster_indices = []\\n    all_clusters = []\\n    probe_region_labels = []\\n\\n    for probe_idx in range(session['n_probes']):\\n        clusters = session['clusters'][probe_idx]\\n\\n        # Get probe location\\n        if probe_idx < len(session['probe_locations']):\\n            loc = session['probe_locations'][probe_idx]\\n        else:\\n            loc = 'ALM'\\n\\n        # Filter by quality (matching findClusters.m with quality='all')\\n        valid_units = filter_clusters(clusters)\\n\\n        if len(valid_units) == 0:\\n            continue\\n\\n        # Compute firing rates for this probe\\n        trialdat_probe, mean_frs = align_and_bin_spikes(\\n            clusters, valid_units, session['goCue'], trial_mask,\\n            EDGES, DT, SMOOTH_MS\\n        )\\n\\n        # Filter by firing rate (matching removeLowFRClusters.m)\\n        fr_mask = mean_frs > LOW_FR\\n        kept_units = [valid_units[i] for i in range(len(valid_units)) if fr_mask[i]]\\n        trialdat_probe = trialdat_probe[:, fr_mask, :]\\n\\n        print(f\\\"  Probe {probe_idx} ({loc}): {len(clusters)} total -> {len(valid_units)} quality-filtered -> {len(kept_units)} FR-filtered units\\\")\\n\\n        all_clusters.append(trialdat_probe)\\n        for _ in kept_units:\\n            probe_region_labels.append(loc)\\n\\n    if len(all_clusters) == 0:\\n        print(f\\\"  SKIPPING: no valid clusters\\\")\\n        return None\\n\\n    # Concatenate across probes: (n_timebins, n_total_units, n_trials)\\n    neural_data = np.concatenate(all_clusters, axis=1)\\n    n_units = neural_data.shape[1]\\n    n_trials = neural_data.shape[2]\\n    print(f\\\"  Neural data shape: {neural_data.shape} (time, units, trials)\\\")\\n\\n    if n_units == 0:\\n        print(f\\\"  SKIPPING: 0 valid units after filtering\\\")\\n        return None\\n\\n    # --- Extract behavioral variables ---\\n    lick_direction = session['R'][valid_trials].astype(np.int32)  # R=1, L=0\\n    context = (1 - session['autowater'][valid_trials]).astype(np.int32)  # DR=1, WC=0\\n    outcome = session['hit'][valid_trials].astype(np.int32)  # correct=1, incorrect=0\\n\\n    print(f\\\"  Lick direction: R={np.sum(lick_direction==1)}, L={np.sum(lick_direction==0)}\\\")\\n    print(f\\\"  Context: DR={np.sum(context==1)}, WC={np.sum(context==0)}\\\")\\n    print(f\\\"  Outcome: correct={np.sum(outcome==1)}, incorrect={np.sum(outcome==0)}\\\")\\n\\n    # --- Extract kinematic features ---\\n    go_cue_times = session['goCue']\\n\\n    # Tongue velocity from side camera (cam 0), feature 'tongue'\\n    tongue_vel = extract_kinematic_feature(session, 0, 'tongue', valid_trials, go_cue_times)\\n\\n    # Paw velocity from bottom camera (cam 1)\\n    paw_vel = None\\n    if len(session['traj']) > 1:\\n        # Try top_paw first, then bottom_paw\\n        paw_vel = extract_kinematic_feature(session, 1, 'top_paw', valid_trials, go_cue_times)\\n        if paw_vel is None:\\n            paw_vel = extract_kinematic_feature(session, 1, 'bottom_paw', valid_trials, go_cue_times)\\n\\n        # If we got one paw, try to average with the other\\n        if paw_vel is not None:\\n            paw_vel2 = extract_kinematic_feature(session, 1, 'bottom_paw', valid_trials, go_cue_times)\\n            if paw_vel2 is not None:\\n                paw_vel = (paw_vel + paw_vel2) / 2.0\\n\\n    # Motion energy\\n    me_interp = None\\n    if me is not None:\\n        me_interp = interpolate_motion_energy(me['data'], session, valid_trials, go_cue_times)\\n\\n    # --- Discretize continuous outputs ---\\n    if tongue_vel is not None:\\n        tongue_vel_disc = discretize_per_session(tongue_vel)\\n    else:\\n        print(f\\\"  Warning: No tongue velocity data, using zeros\\\")\\n        tongue_vel_disc = np.zeros((N_TIMEBINS, n_trials), dtype=np.int32)\\n\\n    if paw_vel is not None:\\n        paw_vel_disc = discretize_per_session(paw_vel)\\n    else:\\n        print(f\\\"  Warning: No paw velocity data, using zeros\\\")\\n        paw_vel_disc = np.zeros((N_TIMEBINS, n_trials), dtype=np.int32)\\n\\n    if me_interp is not None:\\n        me_disc = discretize_per_session(me_interp)\\n    else:\\n        print(f\\\"  Warning: No motion energy data, using zeros\\\")\\n        me_disc = np.zeros((N_TIMEBINS, n_trials), dtype=np.int32)\\n\\n    # --- Format per-trial data ---\\n    neural_trials = []\\n    input_trials = []\\n    output_trials = []\\n\\n    for ti in range(n_trials):\\n        # Neural: (n_units, n_timebins)\\n        neural_trial = neural_data[:, :, ti].T.astype(np.float32)\\n        neural_trials.append(neural_trial)\\n\\n        # Input: time from go cue (1, n_timebins)\\n        input_trial = TIME_AXIS.reshape(1, -1).astype(np.float32)\\n        input_trials.append(input_trial)\\n\\n        # Output: (6, n_timebins) - per-trial values tiled, time-varying ones as-is\\n        output_trial = np.zeros((6, N_TIMEBINS), dtype=np.int32)\\n        output_trial[0, :] = lick_direction[ti]  # per-trial\\n        output_trial[1, :] = context[ti]  # per-trial\\n        output_trial[2, :] = outcome[ti]  # per-trial\\n        output_trial[3, :] = tongue_vel_disc[:, ti]  # time-varying\\n        output_trial[4, :] = paw_vel_disc[:, ti]  # time-varying\\n        output_trial[5, :] = me_disc[:, ti]  # time-varying\\n        output_trials.append(output_trial)\\n\\n    # --- Brain region info ---\\n    # Clean up region labels\\n    region_labels_clean = []\\n    for label in probe_region_labels:\\n        label_clean = label.strip()\\n        # Normalize common variations\\n        if 'ALM' in label_clean.upper():\\n            label_clean = 'ALM'\\n        elif 'TJM1' in label_clean.upper() or 'M1' in label_clean.upper():\\n            label_clean = 'tjM1'\\n        region_labels_clean.append(label_clean)\\n\\n    return {\\n        'neural': neural_trials,\\n        'input': input_trials,\\n        'output': output_trials,\\n        'animal': animal,\\n        'date': date,\\n        'region_labels': region_labels_clean,\\n        'n_units': n_units,\\n        'n_trials': n_trials,\\n    }\\n\\n\\ndef find_session_files(data_dirs):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Find all data_structure and motionEnergy file pairs.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    sessions = []\\n\\n    for data_dir in data_dirs:\\n        if not os.path.isdir(data_dir):\\n            continue\\n\\n        data_files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(data_dir, 'data_structure_*.mat')))\\n\\n        for df in data_files:\\n            basename = os.path.basename(df)\\n            # Extract animal_date from data_structure_ANIMAL_DATE.mat\\n            parts = basename.replace('data_structure_', '').replace('.mat', '')\\n            me_file = os.path.join(data_dir, f'motionEnergy_{parts}.mat')\\n\\n            if not os.path.exists(me_file):\\n                me_file = None\\n\\n            sessions.append({\\n                'data_file': df,\\n                'me_file': me_file,\\n                'animal_date': parts,\\n            })\\n\\n    return sessions\\n\\n\\ndef convert_data(data_dirs=DATA_DIRS, max_sessions=None, output_file='converted_data.pkl'):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Main conversion function.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    # Find all session files\\n    session_files = find_session_files(data_dirs)\\n    print(f\\\"Found {len(session_files)} sessions\\\")\\n\\n    if max_sessions is not None:\\n        session_files = session_files[:max_sessions]\\n        print(f\\\"Processing first {max_sessions} sessions\\\")\\n\\n    # Process each session\\n    all_neural = []\\n    all_input = []\\n    all_output = []\\n    all_animals = []\\n    all_dates = []\\n    all_region_labels = []\\n\\n    for idx, sf in enumerate(session_files):\\n        result = process_session(sf['data_file'], sf['me_file'], idx)\\n\\n        if result is None:\\n            continue\\n\\n        all_neural.append(result['neural'])\\n        all_input.append(result['input'])\\n        all_output.append(result['output'])\\n        all_animals.append(result['animal'])\\n        all_dates.append(result['date'])\\n        all_region_labels.append(result['region_labels'])\\n\\n    n_sessions = len(all_neural)\\n    print(f\\\"\\\\n=== Successfully processed {n_sessions} sessions ===\\\")\\n\\n    if n_sessions == 0:\\n        print(\\\"ERROR: No sessions processed successfully\\\")\\n        return None\\n\\n    # --- Build subject index ---\\n    unique_subjects = sorted(set(all_animals))\\n    subject_idx = np.array([unique_subjects.index(a) for a in all_animals], dtype=np.int64)\\n\\n    # --- Build brain region index ---\\n    all_regions_flat = set()\\n    for labels in all_region_labels:\\n        all_regions_flat.update(labels)\\n    brain_regions = sorted(all_regions_flat)\\n\\n    brain_region_idx = []\\n    for labels in all_region_labels:\\n        idx_arr = np.array([brain_regions.index(l) for l in labels], dtype=np.int64)\\n        brain_region_idx.append(idx_arr)\\n\\n    # Include unlabeled units (matching MATLAB 'all' behavior which includes empty strings)\\n            indices.append(i)\\n    return indices\\n\\n\\ndef align_and_bin_spikes(clusters, cluster_indices, go_cue_times, trial_mask,\\n                         edges, dt, smooth_samples):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Align spikes to goCue, bin, smooth, and compute firing rates.\\n\\n    Returns:\\n        trialdat: (n_timebins, n_units, n_trials) firing rate array\\n        mean_frs: (n_units,) mean firing rate per unit\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    valid_trials = np.where(trial_mask)[0]\\n    n_trials = len(valid_trials)\\n    n_units = len(cluster_indices)\\n    n_timebins = len(edges) - 1\\n\\n    trialdat = np.zeros((n_timebins, n_units, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n    for ui, ci in enumerate(cluster_indices):\\n        unit = clusters[ci]\\n        spike_times = unit['trialtm']\\n        spike_trials = unit['trial']\\n\\n        for ti, trial_idx in enumerate(valid_trials):\\n            trial_num = trial_idx + 1  # MATLAB 1-indexed\\n            go_time = go_cue_times[trial_idx]\\n\\n            if np.isnan(go_time) or go_time == 0:\\n                continue\\n\\n            # Find spikes for this trial\\n            spike_mask = spike_trials == trial_num\\n            if not np.any(spike_mask):\\n                continue\\n\\n            # Align to go cue\\n            aligned_times = spike_times[spike_mask] - go_time\\n\\n            # Bin spikes\\n            counts, _ = np.histogram(aligned_times, bins=edges)\\n            counts = counts[:n_timebins].astype(float)\\n\\n            # Convert to firing rate and smooth\\n            fr = counts / dt\\n            fr_smooth = causal_gaussian_smooth(fr, smooth_samples)\\n            trialdat[:, ui, ti] = fr_smooth\\n\\n    # Compute mean firing rate per unit (across all trials and time)\\n    # Matching removeLowFRClusters.m: mean of mean across conditions\\n    # For simplicity, use mean across all time and trials\\n    mean_frs = np.mean(np.mean(trialdat, axis=2), axis=0)\\n\\n    return trialdat, mean_frs\\n\\n\\ndef compute_velocity(positions, dt_video=1/400):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute velocity magnitude from x,y positions.\\n\\n    positions: (n_frames, 2) array of [x, y]\\n    Returns: (n_frames,) velocity magnitude\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if positions is None or len(positions) < 2:\\n        return None\\n\\n    # Compute velocity as first derivative\\n    dx = np.gradient(positions[:, 0], dt_video)\\n    dy = np.gradient(positions[:, 1], dt_video)\\n    velocity = np.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2)\\n    return velocity\\n\\n\\ndef extract_kinematic_feature(session, cam_idx, feat_name, valid_trials, go_cue_times):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Extract and interpolate a kinematic feature velocity to neural time axis.\\n\\n    Returns:\\n        velocities: (n_timebins, n_trials) array or None\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if cam_idx >= len(session['traj']):\\n        return None\\n\\n    cam = session['traj'][cam_idx]\\n    feat_names = [fn.lower() for fn in cam['feat_names']]\\n\\n    # Find feature index\\n    feat_idx = None\\n    for i, fn in enumerate(feat_names):\\n        if feat_name.lower() in fn:\\n            feat_idx = i\\n            break\\n\\n    if feat_idx is None:\\n        return None\\n\\n    vidshift = session.get('vidshift', 0.0)\\n    n_trials = len(valid_trials)\\n    velocities = np.full((N_TIMEBINS, n_trials), np.nan, dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n    for ti, trial_idx in enumerate(valid_trials):\\n        if trial_idx >= len(cam['trials']):\\n            continue\\n\\n        trial_data = cam['trials'][trial_idx]\\n        ts = trial_data.get('ts')\\n        frame_times = trial_data.get('frameTimes')\\n\\n        if ts is None:\\n            continue\\n\\n        # Handle NdroppedFrames\\n        if np.isnan(trial_data.get('NdroppedFrames', 0)):\\n            continue\\n\\n        go_time = go_cue_times[trial_idx]\\n        if np.isnan(go_time) or go_time == 0:\\n            continue\\n\\n        # ts shape from HDF5: may be transposed\\n        # In MATLAB: ts(n_frames, 3, n_features) where 3=[x,y,likelihood]\\n        # In HDF5 (column-major): could be (n_features, 3, n_frames)\\n        if ts.ndim == 3:\\n            # Try to figure out the right shape\\n            # The 3 should be [x, y, likelihood]\\n            if ts.shape[0] == 3:\\n                # (3, n_features, n_frames) -> need (n_frames, 3, n_features)\\n                ts = np.transpose(ts, (2, 0, 1))\\n            elif ts.shape[1] == 3:\\n                # (n_features, 3, n_frames) -> need (n_frames, 3, n_features)\\n                ts = np.transpose(ts, (2, 1, 0))\\n            elif ts.shape[2] == 3:\\n                # Already (n_frames, n_features, 3) -> need (n_frames, 3, n_features)\\n                ts = np.transpose(ts, (0, 2, 1))\\n\\n            n_frames = ts.shape[0]\\n            if feat_idx >= ts.shape[2]:\\n                continue\\n\\n            # Extract x, y for the feature\\n            xy = ts[:, :2, feat_idx]  # (n_frames, 2)\\n        else:\\n            continue\\n\\n        # Fill missing values (nearest) for non-tongue features\\n        if 'tongue' not in feat_name.lower():\\n            for col in range(2):\\n                mask = np.isnan(xy[:, col])\\n                if mask.any() and not mask.all():\\n                    valid_idx = np.where(~mask)[0]\\n                    xy[mask, col] = np.interp(\\n                        np.where(mask)[0], valid_idx, xy[valid_idx, col]\\n                    )\\n\\n        # Compute velocity\\n        vel = compute_velocity(xy, 1/400)\\n        if vel is None:\\n            continue\\n\\n        # Create frame times if not available\\n        if frame_times is None or np.all(np.isnan(frame_times)):\\n            frame_times = np.arange(1, n_frames + 1) / 400.0\\n\\n        # Align to go cue and interpolate to neural time axis\\n        aligned_frame_times = frame_times - vidshift - go_time\\n\\n        try:\\n            interp_fn = interp1d(aligned_frame_times, vel,\\n                                kind='linear', bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan)\\n            velocities[:, ti] = interp_fn(TIME_AXIS)\\n        except:\\n            continue\\n\\n    # Fill NaN with nearest valid values\\n    for ti in range(n_trials):\\n        col = velocities[:, ti]\\n        mask = np.isnan(col)\\n        if mask.any() and not mask.all():\\n            valid_idx = np.where(~mask)[0]\\n            col[mask] = np.interp(np.where(mask)[0], valid_idx, col[valid_idx])\\n            velocities[:, ti] = col\\n        elif mask.all():\\n            velocities[:, ti] = 0.0\\n\\n    return velocities\\n\\n\\ndef interpolate_motion_energy(me_data, session, valid_trials, go_cue_times):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Interpolate motion energy to neural time axis, aligned to go cue.\\n\\n    Matching loadMotionEnergy.m logic.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    vidshift = session.get('vidshift', 0.0)\\n    n_trials = len(valid_trials)\\n    me_interp = np.full((N_TIMEBINS, n_trials), np.nan, dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n    for ti, trial_idx in enumerate(valid_trials):\\n        if trial_idx >= len(me_data):\\n            continue\\n\\n        me_trial = me_data[trial_idx]\\n        go_time = go_cue_times[trial_idx]\\n\\n        if np.isnan(go_time) or go_time == 0:\\n            continue\\n\\n        if me_trial is None or len(me_trial) == 0:\\n            continue\\n\\n        n_frames = len(me_trial)\\n\\n        # Get frame times\\n        # Try to use traj frameTimes, otherwise fall back\\n        frame_times = None\\n        if len(session['traj']) > 0 and trial_idx < len(session['traj'][0]['trials']):\\n            ft = session['traj'][0]['trials'][trial_idx].get('frameTimes')\\n            if ft is not None and not np.all(np.isnan(ft)):\\n                frame_times = ft\\n\\n        if frame_times is None:\\n            frame_times = np.arange(1, n_frames + 1) / 400.0\\n            aligned_frame_times = frame_times - 0.5 - go_time  # fallback offset\\n        else:\\n            # Trim/pad to match me_trial length\\n            if len(frame_times) > n_frames:\\n                frame_times = frame_times[:n_frames]\\n            elif len(frame_times) < n_frames:\\n                # Extend frame times\\n                dt_vid = 1/400\\n                extra = np.arange(len(frame_times), n_frames) * dt_vid + frame_times[-1] + dt_vid\\n                frame_times = np.concatenate([frame_times, extra])\\n            aligned_frame_times = frame_times - vidshift - go_time\\n\\n        try:\\n            interp_fn = interp1d(aligned_frame_times, me_trial,\\n                                kind='linear', bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan)\\n            me_interp[:, ti] = interp_fn(TIME_AXIS)\\n        except:\\n            continue\\n\\n    # Fill NaN with nearest\\n    for ti in range(n_trials):\\n        col = me_interp[:, ti]\\n        mask = np.isnan(col)\\n        if mask.any() and not mask.all():\\n            valid_idx = np.where(~mask)[0]\\n            col[mask] = np.interp(np.where(mask)[0], valid_idx, col[valid_idx])\\n            me_interp[:, ti] = col\\n        elif mask.all():\\n            me_interp[:, ti] = 0.0\\n\\n    return me_interp\\n\\n\\ndef discretize_per_session(values, percentile=50):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Discretize values into 2 bins using per-session threshold.\\n\\n    values: (n_timebins, n_trials)\\n    Returns: (n_timebins, n_trials) with 0 (< threshold) and 1 (>= threshold)\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    # Compute threshold across all valid values\\n    valid = values[~np.isnan(values)]\\n    if len(valid) == 0:\\n        return np.zeros_like(values, dtype=np.int32)\\n\\n    threshold = np.percentile(valid, percentile)\\n    discretized = (values >= threshold).astype(np.int32)\\n    return discretized\\n\\n\\ndef process_session(session_file, me_file, session_idx_global):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Process a single session and return formatted data.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    basename = os.path.basename(session_file)\\n    parts = basename.replace('data_structure_', '').replace('.mat', '').split('_')\\n    animal = parts[0]\\n    date = '_'.join(parts[1:])\\n\\n    print(f\\\"\\\\n--- Processing session {session_idx_global}: {animal}_{date} ---\\\")\\n\\n    # Load session data\\n    session = load_session_data(session_file)\\n    Ntrials = session['Ntrials']\\n    print(f\\\"  Total trials: {Ntrials}\\\")\\n\\n    # Load motion energy\\n    me = load_motion_energy(me_file) if me_file else None\\n\\n    # --- Trial filtering ---\\n    # Include: non-stim, non-early, responding (hit or miss) trials\\n    # Matching: ~stim.enable & ~early & (hit | miss)\\n    trial_mask = (\\n        (session['stim_enable'] == 0) &\\n        (session['early'] == 0) &\\n        ((session['hit'] == 1) | (session['miss'] == 1))\\n    )\\n\\n    valid_trials = np.where(trial_mask)[0]\\n    n_valid = len(valid_trials)\\n    print(f\\\"  Valid trials (no stim, no early, hit|miss): {n_valid}\\\")\\n\\n    if n_valid < 2:\\n        print(f\\\"  SKIPPING: fewer than 2 valid trials\\\")\\n        return None\\n\\n    # --- Cluster filtering and spike processing ---\\n    # Process all probes\\n    all_cluster_indices = []\\n    all_clusters = []\\n    probe_region_labels = []\\n\\n    for probe_idx in range(session['n_probes']):\\n        clusters = session['clusters'][probe_idx]\\n\\n        # Get probe location\\n        if probe_idx < len(session['probe_locations']):\\n            loc = session['probe_locations'][probe_idx]\\n        else:\\n            loc = 'ALM'\\n\\n        # Filter by quality (matching findClusters.m with quality='all')\\n        valid_units = filter_clusters(clusters)\\n\\n        if len(valid_units) == 0:\\n            continue\\n\\n        # Compute firing rates for this probe\\n        trialdat_probe, mean_frs = align_and_bin_spikes(\\n            clusters, valid_units, session['goCue'], trial_mask,\\n            EDGES, DT, SMOOTH_MS\\n        )\\n\\n        # Filter by firing rate (matching removeLowFRClusters.m)\\n        fr_mask = mean_frs > LOW_FR\\n        kept_units = [valid_units[i] for i in range(len(valid_units)) if fr_mask[i]]\\n        trialdat_probe = trialdat_probe[:, fr_mask, :]\\n\\n        print(f\\\"  Probe {probe_idx} ({loc}): {len(clusters)} total -> {len(valid_units)} quality-filtered -> {len(kept_units)} FR-filtered units\\\")\\n\\n        all_clusters.append(trialdat_probe)\\n        for _ in kept_units:\\n            probe_region_labels.append(loc)\\n\\n    if len(all_clusters) == 0:\\n        print(f\\\"  SKIPPING: no valid clusters\\\")\\n        return None\\n\\n    # Concatenate across probes: (n_timebins, n_total_units, n_trials)\\n    neural_data = np.concatenate(all_clusters, axis=1)\\n    n_units = neural_data.shape[1]\\n    n_trials = neural_data.shape[2]\\n    print(f\\\"  Neural data shape: {neural_data.shape} (time, units, trials)\\\")\\n\\n    if n_units == 0:\\n        print(f\\\"  SKIPPING: 0 valid units after filtering\\\")\\n        return None\\n\\n    # --- Extract behavioral variables ---\\n    lick_direction = session['R'][valid_trials].astype(np.int32)  # R=1, L=0\\n    context = (1 - session['autowater'][valid_trials]).astype(np.int32)  # DR=1, WC=0\\n    outcome = session['hit'][valid_trials].astype(np.int32)  # correct=1, incorrect=0\\n\\n    print(f\\\"  Lick direction: R={np.sum(lick_direction==1)}, L={np.sum(lick_direction==0)}\\\")\\n    print(f\\\"  Context: DR={np.sum(context==1)}, WC={np.sum(context==0)}\\\")\\n    print(f\\\"  Outcome: correct={np.sum(outcome==1)}, incorrect={np.sum(outcome==0)}\\\")\\n\\n    # --- Extract kinematic features ---\\n    go_cue_times = session['goCue']\\n\\n    # Tongue velocity from side camera (cam 0), feature 'tongue'\\n    tongue_vel = extract_kinematic_feature(session, 0, 'tongue', valid_trials, go_cue_times)\\n\\n    # Paw velocity from bottom camera (cam 1)\\n    paw_vel = None\\n    if len(session['traj']) > 1:\\n        # Try top_paw first, then bottom_paw\\n        paw_vel = extract_kinematic_feature(session, 1, 'top_paw', valid_trials, go_cue_times)\\n        if paw_vel is None:\\n            paw_vel = extract_kinematic_feature(session, 1, 'bottom_paw', valid_trials, go_cue_times)\\n\\n        # If we got one paw, try to average with the other\\n        if paw_vel is not None:\\n            paw_vel2 = extract_kinematic_feature(session, 1, 'bottom_paw', valid_trials, go_cue_times)\\n            if paw_vel2 is not None:\\n                paw_vel = (paw_vel + paw_vel2) / 2.0\\n\\n    # Motion energy\\n    me_interp = None\\n    if me is not None:\\n        me_interp = interpolate_motion_energy(me['data'], session, valid_trials, go_cue_times)\\n\\n    # --- Discretize continuous outputs ---\\n    if tongue_vel is not None:\\n        tongue_vel_disc = discretize_per_session(tongue_vel)\\n    else:\\n        print(f\\\"  Warning: No tongue velocity data, using zeros\\\")\\n        tongue_vel_disc = np.zeros((N_TIMEBINS, n_trials), dtype=np.int32)\\n\\n    if paw_vel is not None:\\n        paw_vel_disc = discretize_per_session(paw_vel)\\n    else:\\n        print(f\\\"  Warning: No paw velocity data, using zeros\\\")\\n        paw_vel_disc = np.zeros((N_TIMEBINS, n_trials), dtype=np.int32)\\n\\n    if me_interp is not None:\\n        me_disc = discretize_per_session(me_interp)\\n    else:\\n        print(f\\\"  Warning: No motion energy data, using zeros\\\")\\n        me_disc = np.zeros((N_TIMEBINS, n_trials), dtype=np.int32)\\n\\n    # --- Format per-trial data ---\\n    neural_trials = []\\n    input_trials = []\\n    output_trials = []\\n\\n    for ti in range(n_trials):\\n        # Neural: (n_units, n_timebins)\\n        neural_trial = neural_data[:, :, ti].T.astype(np.float32)\\n        neural_trials.append(neural_trial)\\n\\n        # Input: time from go cue (1, n_timebins)\\n        input_trial = TIME_AXIS.reshape(1, -1).astype(np.float32)\\n        input_trials.append(input_trial)\\n\\n        # Output: (6, n_timebins) - per-trial values tiled, time-varying ones as-is\\n        output_trial = np.zeros((6, N_TIMEBINS), dtype=np.int32)\\n        output_trial[0, :] = lick_direction[ti]  # per-trial\\n        output_trial[1, :] = context[ti]  # per-trial\\n        output_trial[2, :] = outcome[ti]  # per-trial\\n        output_trial[3, :] = tongue_vel_disc[:, ti]  # time-varying\\n        output_trial[4, :] = paw_vel_disc[:, ti]  # time-varying\\n        output_trial[5, :] = me_disc[:, ti]  # time-varying\\n        output_trials.append(output_trial)\\n\\n    # --- Brain region info ---\\n    # Clean up region labels\\n    region_labels_clean = []\\n    for label in probe_region_labels:\\n        label_clean = label.strip()\\n        # Normalize common variations\\n        if 'ALM' in label_clean.upper():\\n            label_clean = 'ALM'\\n        elif 'TJM1' in label_clean.upper() or 'M1' in label_clean.upper():\\n            label_clean = 'tjM1'\\n        region_labels_clean.append(label_clean)\\n\\n    return {\\n        'neural': neural_trials,\\n        'input': input_trials,\\n        'output': output_trials,\\n        'animal': animal,\\n        'date': date,\\n        'region_labels': region_labels_clean,\\n        'n_units': n_units,\\n        'n_trials': n_trials,\\n    }\\n\\n\\ndef find_session_files(data_dirs):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Find all data_structure and motionEnergy file pairs.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    sessions = []\\n\\n    for data_dir in data_dirs:\\n        if not os.path.isdir(data_dir):\\n            continue\\n\\n        data_files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(data_dir, 'data_structure_*.mat')))\\n\\n        for df in data_files:\\n            basename = os.path.basename(df)\\n            # Extract animal_date from data_structure_ANIMAL_DATE.mat\\n            parts = basename.replace('data_structure_', '').replace('.mat', '')\\n            me_file = os.path.join(data_dir, f'motionEnergy_{parts}.mat')\\n\\n            if not os.path.exists(me_file):\\n                me_file = None\\n\\n            sessions.append({\\n                'data_file': df,\\n                'me_file': me_file,\\n                'animal_date': parts,\\n            })\\n\\n    return sessions\\n\\n\\ndef convert_data(data_dirs=DATA_DIRS, max_sessions=None, output_file='converted_data.pkl'):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Main conversion function.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    # Find all session files\\n    session_files = find_session_files(data_dirs)\\n    print(f\\\"Found {len(session_files)} sessions\\\")\\n\\n    if max_sessions is not None:\\n        session_files = session_files[:max_sessions]\\n        print(f\\\"Processing first {max_sessions} sessions\\\")\\n\\n    # Process each session\\n    all_neural = []\\n    all_input = []\\n    all_output = []\\n    all_animals = []\\n    all_dates = []\\n    all_region_labels = []\\n\\n    for idx, sf in enumerate(session_files):\\n        result = process_session(sf['data_file'], sf['me_file'], idx)\\n\\n        if result is None:\\n            continue\\n\\n        all_neural.append(result['neural'])\\n        all_input.append(result['input'])\\n        all_output.append(result['output'])\\n        all_animals.append(result['animal'])\\n        all_dates.append(result['date'])\\n        all_region_labels.append(result['region_labels'])\\n\\n    n_sessions = len(all_neural)\\n    print(f\\\"\\\\n=== Successfully processed {n_sessions} sessions ===\\\")\\n\\n    if n_sessions == 0:\\n        print(\\\"ERROR: No sessions processed successfully\\\")\\n        return None\\n\\n    # --- Build subject index ---\\n    unique_subjects = sorted(set(all_animals))\\n    subject_idx = np.array([unique_subjects.index(a) for a in all_animals], dtype=np.int64)\\n\\n    # --- Build brain region index ---\\n    all_regions_flat = set()\\n    for labels in all_region_labels:\\n        all_regions_flat.update(labels)\\n    brain_regions = sorted(all_regions_flat)\\n\\n    brain_region_idx = []\\n    for labels in all_region_labels:\\n        idx_arr = np.array([brain_regions.index(l) for l in labels], dtype=np.int64)\\n        brain_region_idx.append(idx_arr)\\n\\n    #
